body_text:
The dual map of a linear map $T:V\to W$ is $T^*:W^*\to V^*$,
defined by $T^*(\lambda)=\lambda\circ T$. It reverses the
direction of arrows because a measurement on the codomain can
be pulled back to a measurement on the domain. In finite
dimensions, the matrix of $T^*$ in dual bases is the transpose
of the matrix of $T$.
